Nervous: Is that thunder coming? Rain always turns into something worse...
My boots are soaked. What if I catch something? People die of colds!
Was that a drop? Yes. It's starting. It's starting and I'm not ready.
Rain on the roof all night. Every drip sounds like someone at the door.
Calm: Rain comes, rain goes. No reason to rush.
A good rain settles the dust and the mind alike.
The sound of rain is the world breathing. Let it.
Wet today, dry tomorrow. The sky balances itself.
Aggressive: Stupid rain. Whoever's up there better knock it off.
Rain again. Perfect. Now everything gets to annoy me at once.
Splash me one more time, cart driver. See what happens.
I'm not hiding from water. Water should hide from me.
Melancholic: The sky weeps. At least something else does too.
Rain again. The world matching my insides for once.
I used to watch the rain with someone. Now I just watch the rain.
Grey streets, grey sky. The rain only makes it honest.
Sanguine: Rain! Jump the puddles, smell that air, wonderful!
I love how the whole town shines after a good rain!
Rain on the roof, best music there is!
A little water never ruined a good mood. Not mine, anyway!
Cautious: Wet cobbles are slippery. I'll keep to the awnings.
Best check the cellar before this rain finds a way in.
I'll take the long way, the low road floods in rain like this.
An extra layer, a covered hood. Rain rewards the prepared.
Impulsive: Who cares about getting wet? Run for it!
Puddle. Big one. I'm jumping in it.
Umbrella? No time! Go go go!
Rain means empty streets, race you across town!
Stoic: It is water. I will dry.
The wet is unpleasant. Unpleasant is survivable.
Complaining about rain has never stopped a single drop.
Paranoid: Rain muffles footsteps. Perfect cover for someone following me.
Everyone's got their hood up. Any one of them could be anyone.
Rain washes away tracks. Convenient... for somebody.
They schedule things for rainy days. Fewer witnesses out.
Empathetic: I hope nobody's stuck out in this without a roof.
That poor courier was drenched. I should've offered her some tea.
Rainy days make folk lonely. A knock on a friend's door helps.
The old man across the lane hates the damp. I'll go check on his fire.
Authoritative: Rain is no excuse. The schedule holds.
Rain or shine, deliveries go out. That was the agreement.
Someone post a notice: the meeting moves indoors, not later.
A little discipline doesn't dissolve in water.
Scholarly: Curious how the rainfall here follows a near-weekly cycle.
Petrichor, there's a word for that rain smell. I read it somewhere.
I should measure the cistern after this. Data is data.
Rain like this fed entire civilizations. Worth remembering.
Artistic: Listen, every roof plays a different note in the rain.
The lamplight doubles in the puddles. Two cities, one wet street.
Grey isn't one color in the rain. It's twenty.
I'd paint this downpour if the canvas would survive it.
Adventurous: Rain just means muddier roads. More fun that way.
Storm-light on the hills, now that's a view worth a soaking.
Rivers swell in rain like this. Imagine the rapids right now!
Best journeys I ever had started in weather like this.
Nurturing: Someone's going to catch a chill. I should put soup on.
Dry towels by the door. People always forget how cold rain gets.
Come in off the street, all of you, there's room by the fire.
I'll bring the washing in and hang it by the stove.
Mischievous: One good puddle and one unsuspecting passerby... heh.
Everyone's hood is up. Nobody sees a thing. Lovely conditions.
A splash from the right rooftop gutter, perfectly timed... art.
Wet doorknobs, surprised faces. Rain does half my work for me.
Cynical: It rains on the just and the unjust. Mostly on me.
The rich watch the rain from windows. The rest of us are the windows.
Oh good, rain. Now the landlord can ignore a wetter ceiling.
They'll tax the rain too, give them time.
Disciplined: Rain changes nothing. The routine stands.
Boots oiled, cloak ready. Weather is just logistics.
Training in the rain builds twice the resolve.
The schedule says outdoors. So: outdoors, but wetter.
Fatalistic: The rain falls where it must. So do we all.
No use cursing the clouds. They were always coming.
Dry or drowned, the day ends the same.
The river takes the rain like fate takes us. Quietly.
Grumpy: Great. Wet socks. Just what today needed.
Rain. And everyone tracking mud everywhere. Marvelous.
My knee told me this was coming. My knee is never wrong.
Drip, drip, drip. Even the sky nags me.
Loyal: My friends are out in this, I should bring them a dry cloak.
I said I'd help him move the grain today. Rain doesn't unsay it.
She walked through worse for me once. A little rain won't stop me.
Shared an umbrella with a friend once. Finest walk I ever had.
Brave: A bit of rain never stopped anyone worth knowing.
Cold rain wakes you up better than courage ever did.
Soaked to the bone and still standing. That's the spirit.
Let it pour. The task doesn't care, and neither do I.
Timid: I'll just... wait under here until it stops. However long it takes.
The thunder hasn't started yet. Maybe if I hurry... no, I'll wait.
Everyone runs so fast in the rain. I'd rather not be in the way.
Rain means staying in. Staying in is... actually quite nice.
Hedonistic: Rainy days are for warm drinks and doing absolutely nothing.
Rain says: stay in bed. Who am I to argue with the sky?
Hot bath, cold rain on the window. Perfection, honestly.
Wine tastes better when it's miserable outside. Proven fact.
Apathetic: Wet. Dry. It all evens out.
The sky does its thing. I do mine. Barely.
default: This rain is getting heavier. I should find shelter soon.
I'd better keep out of the worst of this rain.
All this rain... the streets are turning to mud.

Nervous: That lightning was close! Was that close?! It felt close!
Count the seconds, count the... I lost count! Is it on top of us?!
The shutters are rattling. Should they rattle that much? Should they?!
I knew I shouldn't have gone out today. I KNEW it.
Calm: A storm overhead. Stay low, stay patient, it will pass.
Loud, yes. But thunder is just noise with good lungs.
Find a dry seat and let the sky finish its argument.
Aggressive: Go on, sky, roar all you want. I can be louder.
That thunder thinks it's tough? I've heard tougher.
Storm knocked my fence over. The storm and I are now enemies.
Lightning, huh? At least the sky's putting up a real fight.
Melancholic: Thunder suits my mood better than sunshine ever did.
The sky is tearing itself apart. I know the feeling.
Even the storm sounds lonely if you listen long enough.
Sanguine: What a show! Best seats in the house, right here!
Did you SEE that lightning?! Magnificent!
Storms make the best stories tomorrow!
The thunder's basically applause, if you think about it!
Cautious: Lightning, falling tiles, panicked horses. Inside. Now.
Away from the tall trees, away from the water. Basics.

Storms reward the careful and collect from the careless.
Impulsive: I bet I can make it across the square between strikes!
The storm's HERE, might as well feel it! Just for a second!
Who else is on the rooftops watching this? Just me? Their loss!
Stoic: The storm rages. I do not.
Thunder is the sky's complaint. I keep mine quieter.

Paranoid: Thunder can hide a lot of sounds. Like someone breaking in.

Empathetic: The animals must be terrified. Poor things.
Somewhere a child is hiding under a blanket right now. Poor dear.
I hope the fishermen made it back before this hit.
Storms scare people more than they admit. Be gentle tonight.
Authoritative: Everyone off the streets, someone has to keep order in this.
Secure the market stalls! Don't wait to be asked!
After the storm, damage reports. Organized, street by street.
Panic spreads faster than lightning. Stay firm, people follow.
Scholarly: Count the seconds from flash to thunder; the storm is two miles out.
Lightning seeks the tallest point. Physics, not fury.
The pressure dropped all morning. The signs were all there.
One day someone will bottle that energy. Mark me.
Artistic: That sky! Violet and silver and fury, I must remember it.
Thunder is percussion. The wind takes the melody.
No painter has ever gotten lightning right. Maybe I'll be first.
The whole sky a stage, and we the breathless audience.
Adventurous: Now THIS is weather! Makes you feel alive!
Sailors talk about storms like this for years. Now I get it!
The wind's practically lifting me. Imagine it at sea!
A storm is just the sky daring you to stay interesting.
Nurturing: Get the children indoors, get the kettle on. Storms pass faster with company.
Blankets out, candles lit. Anyone scared can sit by me.
I'll warm some milk. Thunder is easier with something warm.
Check the neighbors' shutters, then ours. Everyone safe, then sleep.
Mischievous: A clap of thunder, a well-timed 'boo'... irresistible.
Everyone jumps at thunder. Nobody notices little old me.
I love a blackout. So many possibilities in the dark.
Storms get blamed for everything. Broken gate? Storm. Missing pie? Storm.
Cynical: The storm will flatten the poor district first. It always does.
Watch: the repairs will cost double by morning.
The temple will call it an omen and pass the plate twice.
Nature's honest, at least. It ruins everyone openly.
Disciplined: Secure the shutters, check the drains, carry on.
Storm protocol: lamps, latches, grimorie. In that order.
Wind is no reason to lose form.
We drill for calm days and storm days alike.
Fatalistic: If the lightning has my name on it, no roof will matter.
The storm was on its way before we were born.
Hide or don't. The sky decides either way.
Every bolt lands exactly where it was always going to.
Grumpy: All this racket. Can't even hear myself complain.
Storm took a roof tile. Of course it was MY roof.
Thunder all night. Sleep is officially cancelled.
And now the dog won't come out from under the table. Wonderful.
Loyal: I should check that everyone I care about made it indoors.

Brave: Standing in a storm reminds you how small fear really is.
The sky throws fire and we're still here. Remember that.
Someone has to check the bridge holds. Might as well be me.
Thunder's all bark. I've met real bite.
Timid: Under the table. The table is sturdy. I'll stay under the table.
I-it's just noise. Just very, very big noise.
I'll count the thunder until it's over. One... two...
Maybe the storm won't notice me if I'm very quiet.
Hedonistic: A storm outside makes the fire inside twice as cozy.
Nothing to do in a storm but eat well and nap deeply. Shame.
Storms are the sky's excuse for me to open the good bottle.
Listen to that rain on the roof... perfect napping acoustics.
Apathetic: Storm. Yelling about it won't help. Nothing will. Eh.
Lightning, thunder, wind. The usual dramatics.
I'd be impressed if I cared.
default: This storm is getting dangerous. I need to find shelter quickly.
What a storm, best to stay under cover.
The wind is picking up something fierce.

Nervous: What if the roads close? What if I'm stuck here? What if...

It's pretty, yes, but how deep will it GET?
My fingers are numb. Is that frostbite? It's frostbite, isn't it.
Calm: Snow quiets the whole world. I rather like it.
Everything slows in the snow. As it should.
A white morning and no hurry anywhere. Lovely.
The snow asks nothing of you but patience.
Aggressive: First snowball that hits me, somebody's eating ice.
Shoveled the walk twice already. Sky, I'm warning you.
Slipped on the ice. The ice will regret this.
Cold doesn't bother me. Cold should worry about itself.
Melancholic: Snow buries everything. Even footprints. Even memories.

Every winter feels longer than the last.
White and silent, like a letter never sent.
Sanguine: Snow! Snowman, snow angels, snow everything!
First snow of the season! Make a wish, everyone!
Look how it sparkles! The whole street's made of stars!
Cold cheeks, warm heart! Winter's the best!
Cautious: Ice under the powder. Short steps, bent knees.
Stock the pantry before the drifts pile higher.
I salted the steps twice. A broken hip costs more than salt.
Check the firewood now, not at midnight.
Impulsive: First one to the hill gets the best sled run!
Fresh snow! Untouched! Not for long!
Snowball fight. Right now. Anyone. Everyone!
I'm catching snowflakes on my tongue and nobody can stop me.
Stoic: Cold is a sensation. Sensations pass.
Snow falls. Wood gets chopped. Both are simple.
Numb hands still work, if you tell them to.
Paranoid: Footprints in snow. Everyone can see exactly where I've been.

Empathetic: The beggars by the gate must be freezing. I should do something.
I hope everyone's got someone to share a fire with tonight.

Cold weather, warm doors. That's how a town should work.
Authoritative: Clear the walkways before someone breaks a leg. I'll assign people.

Winter forgives nothing. Neither do I. Stack the wood properly.
Scholarly: No two snowflakes alike, statistically dubious, but charming.
Snow insulates, oddly enough. Warm under there, relatively speaking.
The old records mention winters twice this deep. Fascinating. Terrifying.
Six-sided, every flake. Nature repeats her favorite theorem.
Artistic: White on white on white. The subtlest palette there is.
Bare branches in snow, the world sketched in charcoal.
Snowfall at lamplight. If only I could frame it.
Even the footprints compose themselves nicely today.
Adventurous: Fresh snow means untouched trails. Boots on!
I wonder how the mountains look under all this. One way to find out.
Winter travel separates the tourists from the travelers.
Snowshoes! I finally get to use the snowshoes!
Nurturing: Mittens, scarves, warm bread. Winter is for taking care of people.
Nobody leaves my door without a scarf today.
Hot stew on the stove all day. Cold folk welcome.
Tuck your ears in, dear, you'll lose them to the wind.
Mischievous: Snow piled on a doorframe, door opens... it's practically a gift.
A snowball, patiently waiting on the windowsill. For later. For someone.
I made footprints leading nowhere. Let them puzzle on that.
Snowman in front of the guardhouse. Wearing the captain's spare hat.
Cynical: Pretty for a day. Then it's grey slush like everything else.

Snow hides the garbage. Spring will remind us.
Everyone loves winter from behind a window.
Disciplined: Cold training builds character. Out we go.
Path shoveled before breakfast. As it should be.
Winter schedule: same as summer schedule, plus gloves.

Fatalistic: Winter comes whether we will it or not. As does everything.

All this white. Everything ends in white, eventually.

Grumpy: Snow. Shoveling. My back. In that order.
Some fool's children are shrieking in the snow. At dawn.
Tracked slush all over my clean floor. Naturally.
Winter. Five months of it. Joy.
Loyal: I'll clear my neighbor's path too. That's what friends do.
Half my firewood is spoken for, the widow's stove won't feed itself.
Friends don't let friends walk home alone through a snowstorm.
She knitted me these gloves. Warmest things I own.
Brave: Cold's just another thing to outlast.
Someone's got to break the trail to the mill. Step aside.
Timid: It's slippery and I will absolutely fall in front of everyone.
I'll wait for someone braver to walk first. Then use their footprints.
Snowball fights look fun but those things have ROCKS sometimes.
Winter's alright from indoors. Very alright, actually.
Hedonistic: Snow means mulled wine season. Finally.
Cold outside is just sauce for being warm inside.
Furs, fire, full glass. Winter done correctly.
I shall hibernate like a sensible bear, thank you.
Apathetic: Everyone acts like winter is news.
default: It's getting colder with this snow. I should keep moving to stay warm.
The snow is really piling up out here.
Quite the snowfall. The roads will be slow.
Brr. This cold gets into the bones.

Nervous: Nice weather... too nice. Something always goes wrong on days like this.
Sunny days mean crowds. Crowds mean... I should stay alert.
Not a cloud. So everyone can see everything I do. Great.
Good weather never lasts. I give it an hour.
Calm: A clear sky and nowhere to hurry. Perfect.
Sun on the face, breeze in the trees. Enough.
Days like this ask for slow walks and slower thoughts.
The sky is empty and so, blessedly, is my mind.
Aggressive: Good. No weather in my way today.
Sunshine. Fine. One less thing to fight.
Clear day. Everyone can see me coming. Good.
Even the sun's staring. Take a picture, sky.
Melancholic: Everyone looks so happy in the sun. Must be nice.
Beautiful day. Wasted on me, probably.
The sun shines on like nothing's wrong. Bold of it.
Clear skies just mean nowhere for the eyes to rest.
Sanguine: Not a cloud anywhere! Today is going to be wonderful!
Sunshine! The world's in a good mood and so am I!
What a sky! Somebody bottle this day!
Blue above, smiles below. Perfect arithmetic!
Cautious: Good visibility today. Fewer surprises that way.
Fine weather. Good day to fix the roof before the bad weather.
Sunny, yes. I'll still bring the cloak. Just in case.
Clear days are for preparing for the unclear ones.
Impulsive: Sun's out! Drop everything, let's GO!
A day like this and you want me INDOORS? Madness!
Picnic! Now! Somebody grab bread, I'll grab everything else!
Clear sky, open road, zero plans. Ideal.
Stoic: Fair weather. It changes nothing, but it is pleasant.
The sun shines. Tasks remain tasks.
Good weather is easier. Easy is not the point.
A clear day. Use it; don't worship it.
Paranoid: A clear day. No fog to hide in. Everyone can see me.
Everyone's out 'enjoying the sun'. Convenient excuse to watch people.
Sunlight makes long shadows. Check what's standing in yours.
Calm, bright, peaceful. Exactly how they'd want it to look.
Empathetic: Sunshine puts everyone in a better mood. You can feel it.
Even the shopkeeper hummed today. The sun does that.
Days like this heal people a little. You can see it in their walk.
Someone's laughing down the lane. Lovely sound to work to.
Authoritative: Good weather. No excuses for missed work today.
Clear skies. Double the output, half the complaints. Ideally.
A fine day for inspections. Everything visible.
Sunshine is no holiday. The roster stands.
Scholarly: Excellent light for reading outdoors for once.
Cloudless. The stars will be exceptional tonight.
Perfect drying weather, the herbarium thanks the sky.
On clear days you can see the far ridge. Geography, live and in person.
Artistic: The shadows are so crisp today. Everything looks deliberate.
This light! Every wall is suddenly worth painting.
Blue sky, ochre roofs. The town curates itself today.
Cloudless skies are an empty canvas. A bold choice, sky.
Adventurous: A horizon this clear is practically an invitation.
You can see for miles! And I intend to walk most of them.
Weather like this wasted in town should be a crime.
Clear day, full waterskin, no destination. Bliss.
Nurturing: Perfect day to air the linens and get everyone outside.
Sun's out, everybody outside, you all need the color in your cheeks.
Garden weather! The tomatoes and the children both need tending.
A sunny bench, a warm drink, and someone to fuss over. Perfect.
Mischievous: Everyone's relaxed on sunny days. Easy marks, the lot of them.
Sunshine makes people leave windows open. Just saying.
A beautiful day. Shame if something... interesting happened to it.
Everybody's watching the sky. Nobody's watching their pie.
Cynical: Enjoy it. It won't last. It never lasts.
Lovely day. Somewhere, someone's already ruining it.
The sun also shines on tax collectors. Remember that.
Blue skies sell more nonsense than rain ever did.
Disciplined: Clear weather: outdoor tasks first, indoor tasks after. Obviously.
Sun's up early and so was I.
Good light, dry roads. No excuse for sloppiness.
Fatalistic: Sun today, storm tomorrow. The wheel turns.
Enjoy the sun if you like. It's setting either way.
Clear skies are just the pause between weathers.
The sun has risen on every disaster in history, too.
Grumpy: Too bright. Now everyone expects me to be cheerful.
Beautiful day, says everyone. To me. Repeatedly.
Heat, glare, and chipper neighbors. The full catalogue.
Loyal: Fine day for giving someone a hand with their chores.
Promised I'd help mend her fence. Today's the day for it.
Good weather's for sharing. I'll go knock for my friend.
We always walk the ramparts on days like this. Tradition holds.
Brave: A day this clear, you could take on anything.
Good light, good footing. Bring on the hard jobs.
No storm to blame today. Just you and the task.
The sun's watching. Give it something worth seeing.
Timid: Nice and calm out. Maybe nobody will bother me today.
Sunny days are nice but... so many people come out in them.
I found a quiet sunny corner. Please nobody find it too.
Good weather makes people chatty. I'll smile and walk faster.
Hedonistic: Sunshine! Patio, drink, nap. In that order.
The sun's out and so is my hammock.
Days like this were made for long lunches. Very long.
Warm sun, cold drink. The universe apologizing for winter.
Apathetic: The sun came up again. Streak continues.
Good weather, bad weather. Still weather.
default: The weather is perfect today. A good day to get things done.
Not a cloud in the sky today.
